tool_input.newString:
if read -t 0; then
    INPUT=$(cat)
else
    INPUT="{}"
fi
# TEMP PROBE (ticket 76941e78, reverted before completion): dump raw stdin once.
if [[ ! -f memory-api/crates/session-api/tests/fixtures/posttooluse_hook_stdin_sample.json ]]; then
    echo "$INPUT" > memory-api/crates/session-api/tests/fixtures/posttooluse_hook_stdin_sample.json
fi
TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // .toolName // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null)
tool_input.oldString:
if read -t 0; then
    INPUT=$(cat)
else
    INPUT="{}"
fi
TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // .toolName // "unknown"' 2>/dev/null)
